sql_inventory_order: pg_catalog LANGUAGE internal prokind=f ORDER BY proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(oid),oid
risk_specific_notes: schema_to_xml and table_to_xml support caller-privileged data exports; effective route/privileges unverified
set_config and setval can cause session/sequence effects; nominal SQL EXECUTE is not sufficient to prove an app exploit
SHA2 and text comparison native LEAKPROOF flags are engine flags, not independent permission exemptions
SP-GiST internal index support callbacks should not be deleted based on missing count statistics
row_security_active reports existing row-security status without changing RLS
Regex matching and string functions have input-dependent cost but no reproduced app abuse
method: All full pg_get_functiondef declarations read in four contiguous 50-object blocks, manually categorized by signature/purpose and each native symbol, engine flags, role SQL EXECUTE and registered catalog link counts; compiled native C implementation and effective routes unavailable.
limits: Native compiled bodies, externally routable PostgREST paths, effective GUC/sequence privileges and hosted console settings UNVERIFIED. No private member rows, credentials or sensitive logs read.
disposition: No proven application defect or justified platform deletion; provider-wide baseline incomplete
